attempts.why: Give nested article inside a card/modal a distinct sectioning background (card-sectioning-background-color) so inner card is visually separated from outer modal card instead of identical white-on-white blending.

selfVerify.reason: Nested article#inner bg rgb(251,252,252) is now distinct from outer article#outer bg rgb(255,255,255), not white-on-white. Inner correctly uses sectioning background (card-sectioning-background-color) providing visual separation inside modal.

pick.suspected: Nested article#inner inside dialog>article#outer has identical background-color rgb(255,255,255) to parent modal - no surface distinction. Modal/card selector in _modal.scss/_card.scss is overly broad or does not apply nested-section/variant background (--pico-card-background-color / --pico-card-sectioning-background-color) for article article, causing visual blending of nested card into modal.
